profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft Azure Kubernetes Service
profile.summary: Hello! I'm a Software Engineer at Microsoft on the Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) team. I work with Go, TypeScript, and Kubernetes to build and improve our offerings. You can contact me at olivermerkleyking@gmail.com.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: At Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) working with Azure, Go, TypeScript, and Kubernetes.

company.name: University of North Carolina at Charlotte

positions.title: Web Application Research & Development
positions.description:
• Constructed a full stack web app to modernize and optimize business workflows for an automotive sports company.
• Use efficient methods like chunked uploads to process large pieces of data.
• Programmed with React, Node.js, Python, Flask, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and MongoDB.
Note: This project is confidential so specifics cannot be disclosed.

positions.title: ACM Student Chapter President
positions.description:
• Teach competitive programming competition strategies through semi-weekly meetings and events.
• Organize, plan, and lead activities that foster a community of students interested in computer science.
• Chosen to represent UNC Charlotte at the 2018, 2019, and 2020 International Collegiate Programming Contests.

positions.title: College of Computing and Informatics Teaching Assistant
positions.description: • Instruct students on concepts widely used in computer science including discrete math, coding fundamentals, and software engineering.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Built a full stack bank account administration web app to simplify internal operation workflows.
• Incorporated SSO to enable add, delete, and search functionality based on user account roles.
• Programmed with Angular, TypeScript, GraphQL, NestJS, Docker, AWS, and Capital One in-house tools.

positions.title: IT Application Development Intern
positions.description:
• Utilized Angular, TypeScript, and AWS to create a conversational chatbot management system.
• Leveraged the Lenovo API and JavaScript to populate a hardware database with warranty information.
• Programmed a script with Node.js to retrieve and store mobile asset information from Microsoft Intune.

educations.schoolName: University of North Carolina at Charlotte

certifications.name: Clemson University 2020 Hackathon Winner (Best Use of Google Cloud)
